### Description

Improve the official `gh` skill by documenting how to pass values safely through
`gh api`. Agents frequently mishandle `-f/-F`: raw field sends literal
strings without type conversion or `@` expansion; typed field converts
`true/false/null` numbers, expands `{owner}/{repo}/{branch}` from remotes,
and reads from file when the value starts with `@`. This causes accidental
file reads and failed mutations. The existing section also lacked guidance
about body ambiguity and verification read-back.

Closes #14701

### How did you test this change?

Not tested by execution; change is documentation only in `skills/gh/SKILL.md`. Verified the flags and placeholder behavior against `gh api --help` locally before writing.

### Key points

- Scope limited strictly to docs in skills/gh/SKILL.md.
- `--input` documented as deterministic escape hatch when bodies may start with `@`.

### Notes for reviewers

Review starts at the new `Passing values in gh api` section between
`Fall back to gh api` and `Authentication`.

### Authorship and follow-up

Who wrote this:

- [ ] A human wrote it.
- [x] An agent wrote it under close human direction.
- [ ] An agent wrote it independently, and no human has guided the implementation beyond the initial prompt.

Who answers review comments:

- [x] @fake-contributor will read and reply directly.
- [ ] An agent will draft replies and @fake-contributor will read them before they are posted.
- [ ] Nobody has explicitly committed to replying.
